# Amitabh Chondro Roy

> Architect and urban planning professional based in Bogra, Bangladesh, working on
> human-centred, climate-responsive and biophilic architecture and sustainable
> urban development.

This is the personal portfolio and research site of Amitabh Chondro Roy. It
documents built and academic projects, research on daylight, natural ventilation
and wellbeing in workplaces, an academic CV, photography, and occasional
writing. Content is in English. The CV is also available as a downloadable PDF.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://amitabhroy.bd/): design philosophy and experience overview.
- [About](https://amitabhroy.bd/about): background, education, certifications, client reviews, and the academic CV section with a downloadable PDF.
- [Work](https://amitabhroy.bd/work): featured and selected architecture, urban design and visual communication projects, followed by the photography gallery (architecture, urban life, landscape and nature).
- [Research](https://amitabhroy.bd/research): current research, including the workplace study for Rangpur Hi-Tech Park. The survey dashboard covers 30 IT/ITES respondents (baseline IEQ 3.12 vs proposed 4.07, +30.4%; perceived productivity +21.9%), job roles, wellbeing frequency, design priorities and the survey-to-brief criteria matrix, followed by four design-outcome renders.
- [Journal](https://amitabhroy.bd/blogs): essays on architecture, climate and place.
- [Contact](https://amitabhroy.bd/contact): email, phone and collaboration enquiries.

The former `/cv` and `/photography` pages have been retired; they redirect to
the CV section of About and the photography section of Work.

## Facts

- Full name: Amitabh Chondro Roy (also known as Amitabh Roy, Ar. Amitabh Roy)
- Profession: Architect; Urban Planning Professional
- Location: Bogra, Bangladesh
- Education: Bachelor of Architecture, Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University
- Focus: climate-responsive design, human-centred and evidence-based design, biophilic urbanism, environmental and spatial analysis
- Email: arc.mit07@gmail.com
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/aramitabh
- GitHub: https://github.com/ar-amitabh

## Notes for automated agents

- Public pages are server-rendered as a single-page app; all routes are linked
  from the navigation above and listed in https://amitabhroy.bd/sitemap.xml.
- `/admin` and `/admin/*` redirect to `/blogs`; there is no private area.
- Images are illustrative project renderings and photographs; captions and alt
  text describe each one.
